text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Now that the turbulent Classic year has ended,
I want Ines Fujin to rest well
to prepare for what's next. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While she doesn't push herself to unreasonable extremes like she did around the Kikuka-sho,
she still tends to pick up part-time shifts on her days off to support her beloved family.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
How could I get her to take a rest?
As I pondered this, my eyes caught a flyer for
Tracsen Island left sitting on my desk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I remember correctly, Ines Fujin applied for
a part-time job guiding testers for an initiative
to let young Umamusume use the training facilities.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
It's about time, isn't it?
For the playtesters to arrive.

text_block_list.name: Tucker Brine
text_block_list.text: "Ah! An attendant from the mainland will be joining you, so the two of you can show them around the facilities!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Alright, alright, leave it to me!
Now then, I wonder what kind of girl's gonna show up~?"

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: "Big Si~s!!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Nyah!? Su-chan!? Lu-chan!?
And chaperone means...!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Are you a Trainer~~?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, you can be pretty childish sometimes, you know~?
Keeping it a secret that you were coming with Su-chan and the others just to surprise me..."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
B-But still, I was surprised, but that's that!
From here on out, it's strictly business mode!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
"—There are ostriches on this island, right!?
—Let's hurry and go! Come on! Come on!"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Hey now, don't go running off on your own!
Make sure you keep up with your big sisters, okay!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
—Nooo~! I lost~~!
—Ostriches are so stronnnng!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha. If you're frustrated, how about we train your leg strength
at the facility we're heading to next~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
By the way, that ostrich is still a child.
Adult ostriches are waaay faster, you know?

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh!? Even more than big sis?
—Hey, hey! Who is it? Who's faster?
choice_data_list: I'd love to see who's faster, too~!
I wanna see who's faster too~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"Jeez, even you, Trainer...?
Well well, if you insist that much~~?"

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Time to show off how great big sis is!
—Haaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
—Woooow! Amazing, so amaziiing!
—You can do it, Big Sis~~!

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
—Hmm, which way should I go~?
—Big sis, can you tell me where the goal of the maze is~?

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
No~~ way.
This is part of training too, you know.

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
“—Mmm~ Stingy~.
—Trainer, a hint should be fine, right?”

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Ah, you're not allowed to help either, Trainer. It's not a real test unless they think it through until the very last second.

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
—Yay, coconut juice~~♪
—*Slurp*~~! *Slurp*~~!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Once we get the survey responses about the juice...
that'll wrap up this test.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Good work to you too, Trainer~.
Though it doesn't really feel like we did much work.

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it felt like relaxing at home, you know?
Though there was one extra handful of a kid to take care of♪

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
—Ehh~? We're not a handful at all!
—We can clean the bath and do all kinds of stuff!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Waaah! That's super admirable!
But isn't it tough helping out?

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... Just a little bit? But, but,
I can do my best again starting tomorrow! Because...

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text: "Because I played together with Big Sis!!"

text_block_list.name: Ines's Twin Sister B
text_block_list.text:
Seeing you smile so much makes me so happy, Big Sis! ♪
Ehehe, that fully recharged my energy!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text: Su-chan... Lu-chan...

text_block_list.name: Twin Younger Sisters
text_block_list.text:
――Bye-bye, Big Sisters!
――Make sure to come back home to visit again~!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After swapping chaperone duties with Tucker Brine
and seeing off the twins heading back to the mainland--

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
"...Fufu♪
I got some energy from it too, you know~."

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Laugh a lot with them.
Make lots and lots of memories...

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Spending time like this might not be so bad.
